messages.text: Phone stand: 80 mm wide, back leaning 20 degrees from vertical, a 12 mm slot for the phone with a 10 mm front lip, and a 15 mm wide cut-out in the middle of the lip for the charging cable.
Make it 100 mm wide and add four round pockets, 8 mm diameter and 1 mm deep, under the base for rubber feet.

versions.instruction: Phone stand: 80 mm wide, back leaning 20 degrees from vertical, a 12 mm slot for the phone with a 10 mm front lip, and a 15 mm wide cut-out in the middle of the lip for the charging cable.
versions.base_code:
import math
import cadquery as cq

PARAMS = {
    "width": {"value": 80, "unit": "mm", "min": 50, "max": 150, "label": "Width (X)"},
    "base_thickness": {"value": 6, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 15, "label": "Base thickness"},
    "slot_width": {"value": 12, "unit": "mm", "min": 6, "max": 25, "label": "Phone slot width"},
    "lip_height": {"value": 10, "unit": "mm", "min": 4, "max": 30, "label": "Front lip height"},
    "lip_thickness": {"value": 8, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 20, "label": "Front lip thickness"},
    "back_height": {"value": 90, "unit": "mm", "min": 40, "max": 160, "label": "Back plate height above base"},
    "back_thickness": {"value": 8, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 20, "label": "Back plate thickness"},
    "back_angle": {"value": 20, "unit": "deg", "min": 5, "max": 40, "label": "Back lean from vertical"},
    "rear_extension": {"value": 25, "unit": "mm", "min": 0, "max": 60, "label": "Base extension behind the back plate"},
    "cable_width": {"value": 15, "unit": "mm", "min": 5, "max": 40, "label": "Cable cut-out width"},
}

W = PARAMS["width"]["value"]
T = PARAMS["base_thickness"]["value"]
S = PARAMS["slot_width"]["value"]
LH = PARAMS["lip_height"]["value"]
LT = PARAMS["lip_thickness"]["value"]
BH = PARAMS["back_height"]["value"]
BT = PARAMS["back_thickness"]["value"]
ANG = PARAMS["back_angle"]["value"]
EXT = PARAMS["rear_extension"]["value"]
CW = PARAMS["cable_width"]["value"]

CW = min(CW, W - 10)
off = BH * math.tan(math.radians(ANG))   # how far the top of the plate leans back
yf = LT + S                              # front face of the back plate at the floor
yb = yf + BT                             # rear face of the back plate at the floor
D = yb + max(EXT, off)                   # total depth

# Side profile in the YZ plane (local x = Y, local y = Z), extruded along X.
profile = [
    (0, 0), (D, 0), (D, T), (yb, T),
    (yb + off, T + BH), (yf + off, T + BH),
    (yf, T), (LT, T), (LT, T + LH), (0, T + LH),
]
body = cq.Workplane("YZ").polyline(profile).close().extrude(W / 2, both=True)

# Cable cut-out in the middle of the lip, down to the slot floor.
cut = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(CW, LT + 2, LH + 1, centered=(True, False, False))
    .translate((0, -1, T))
)
result = body.cut(cut).translate((0, -D / 2, 0))

EXPECTED_BBOX = (W, D, T + BH)
EXPECTED_HOLES = []

note.title: phone-stand-20deg
note.summary: Phone stand 80 mm wide. The back plate leans 20° from vertical. A 12 mm slot sits between the back plate and a 10 mm front lip. A 15 mm wide cut-out in the middle of the lip lets the charging cable through.
assumptions: I measured the 12 mm slot along the base, from the lip to the back plate. The phone is about 12 mm thick, or a bit less when it leans.
I chose the base thickness (6 mm), lip thickness (8 mm), back plate height above the base (90 mm) and back plate thickness (8 mm). These are all sliders.
The base extends 25 mm behind the back plate, or as far as the leaning plate reaches if that is more. This keeps the stand from tipping backwards.
The cable cut-out goes down to the floor of the slot.
For FDM, print it lying on its side, with the profile in the XY plane of the bed, so the layers don't split along the lean of the back plate. I made no stress simulation, since no load was specified.
questions: What is the thickness of your phone, with its case? I can adjust the slot to fit.
Do you want the back plate higher or lower than 90 mm?

versions.instruction: Make it 100 mm wide and add four round pockets, 8 mm diameter and 1 mm deep, under the base for rubber feet.
versions.base_code:
import math
import cadquery as cq

PARAMS = {
    "width": {"value": 100, "unit": "mm", "min": 50, "max": 150, "label": "Width (X)"},
    "base_thickness": {"value": 6, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 15, "label": "Base thickness"},
    "slot_width": {"value": 12, "unit": "mm", "min": 6, "max": 25, "label": "Phone slot width"},
    "lip_height": {"value": 10, "unit": "mm", "min": 4, "max": 30, "label": "Front lip height"},
    "lip_thickness": {"value": 8, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 20, "label": "Front lip thickness"},
    "back_height": {"value": 90, "unit": "mm", "min": 40, "max": 160, "label": "Back plate height above base"},
    "back_thickness": {"value": 8, "unit": "mm", "min": 3, "max": 20, "label": "Back plate thickness"},
    "back_angle": {"value": 20, "unit": "deg", "min": 5, "max": 40, "label": "Back lean from vertical"},
    "rear_extension": {"value": 25, "unit": "mm", "min": 0, "max": 60, "label": "Base extension behind the back plate"},
    "cable_width": {"value": 15, "unit": "mm", "min": 5, "max": 40, "label": "Cable cut-out width"},
    "foot_diameter": {"value": 8, "unit": "mm", "min": 4, "max": 20, "label": "Rubber foot pocket diameter"},
    "foot_depth": {"value": 1, "unit": "mm", "min": 0.5, "max": 4, "label": "Rubber foot pocket depth"},
    "foot_inset": {"value": 12, "unit": "mm", "min": 6, "max": 30, "label": "Foot pocket distance from edges"},
}

W = PARAMS["width"]["value"]
T = PARAMS["base_thickness"]["value"]
S = PARAMS["slot_width"]["value"]
LH = PARAMS["lip_height"]["value"]
LT = PARAMS["lip_thickness"]["value"]
BH = PARAMS["back_height"]["value"]
BT = PARAMS["back_thickness"]["value"]
ANG = PARAMS["back_angle"]["value"]
EXT = PARAMS["rear_extension"]["value"]
CW = PARAMS["cable_width"]["value"]
FD = PARAMS["foot_diameter"]["value"]
FDEP = PARAMS["foot_depth"]["value"]
FIN = PARAMS["foot_inset"]["value"]

CW = min(CW, W - 10)
off = BH * math.tan(math.radians(ANG))   # how far the top of the plate leans back
yf = LT + S                              # front face of the back plate at the floor
yb = yf + BT                             # rear face of the back plate at the floor
D = yb + max(EXT, off)                   # total depth

# Keep the foot pockets inside the base and the base solid.
FDEP = min(FDEP, T - 2)
FD = min(FD, W / 2 - 2, D / 2 - 2)
FIN = max(FIN, FD / 2 + 2)
FIN = min(FIN, D / 2 - FD / 2 - 1, W / 2 - FD / 2 - 1)

# Side profile in the YZ plane (local x = Y, local y = Z), extruded along X.
profile = [
    (0, 0), (D, 0), (D, T), (yb, T),
    (yb + off, T + BH), (yf + off, T + BH),
    (yf, T), (LT, T), (LT, T + LH), (0, T + LH),
]
body = cq.Workplane("YZ").polyline(profile).close().extrude(W / 2, both=True)

# Cable cut-out in the middle of the lip, down to the slot floor.
cut = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(CW, LT + 2, LH + 1, centered=(True, False, False))
    .translate((0, -1, T))
)
result = body.cut(cut).translate((0, -D / 2, 0))

# Four round pockets under the base for rubber feet.
pts = [(sx * (W / 2 - FIN), sy * (D / 2 - FIN)) for sx in (-1, 1) for sy in (-1, 1)]
feet = cq.Workplane("XY").pushPoints(pts).circle(FD / 2).extrude(FDEP)
result = result.cut(feet)

EXPECTED_BBOX = (W, D, T + BH)
EXPECTED_HOLES = [(FD, 4)]

note.title: suport-mobil
note.summary: El suport ara fa 100 mm d'ample i té quatre encaixos rodons de Ø8 × 1 mm sota la base, a prop de les cantonades, per enganxar-hi peus de goma.
changes: Quatre encaixos rodons a la cara inferior: Ø8 mm i 1 mm de fondària.
Nous paràmetres: diàmetre, fondària i distància a les vores dels encaixos.
assumptions: Els encaixos són a 12 mm de cada vora de la base, un a cada cantonada.
La fondària màxima queda limitada a la base menys 2 mm, perquè la base no es debiliti.
El tall del cable segueix centrat i amb 15 mm d'ample.
questions: Quin diàmetre i gruix tenen els peus de goma? Si no són de Ø8 × 1 mm, ajusto els encaixos.
